title: From Search to Decision: How Post-Training Shapes Information-Seeking Capabilities in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Information seeking in large language model (LLM) systems increasingly involves decisions about when to acquire information, where to search, and how to evaluate and use evidence. Recent post-training methods have improved several such behaviors, but their objectives and evaluations span different tasks and system settings. This paper organizes research around six interrelated information-seeking capabilities and examines the learning signals, optimization methods, update loci, and credit-assignment mechanisms used to develop them. We synthesize empirical progress in targeted behaviors, end-to-end performance, search control, and generalization. Existing studies report gains in retrieval routing, query refinement, multi-tool exploration, evidence-grounded reasoning, and resource-aware search, although the scope of behavioral evidence varies across capabilities. translated_title: 从搜索到决策：后训练如何塑造大语言模型的信息寻求能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）系统中的信息寻求日益涉及关于何时获取信息、在哪里搜索以及如何评估和使用证据的决策。近期的后训练方法已经改进了若干此类行为，但它们的目标和评估跨越不同的任务和系统设置。本文围绕六项相互关联的信息寻求能力组织相关研究，并考察用于培养这些能力的学习信号、优化方法、更新位置和信用分配机制。我们综合了在针对性行为、端到端性能、搜索控制和泛化方面的实证进展。现有研究报告了在检索路由、查询细化、多工具探索、基于证据的推理和资源感知搜索方面的收益，尽管不同能力的行为证据范围有所差异。我们识别了在估计预期检索效用、协调……（摘要原文在此处截断）等方面尚存的开放挑战。
tldr: 本文系统梳理了大语言模型的六项相互关联的信息寻求能力，综合分析了后训练方法通过学习信号、优化方式和信用分配机制培养这些能力的实证进展，并指出了检索效用预估等方面仍存在的开放挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper organizes research around six interrelated information-seeking capabilities in LLMs, synthesizing how post-training methods' learning signals, optimization approaches, and credit-assignment mechanisms drive empirical progress, while identifying open challenges such as estimating prospective retrieval utility.
